title: What’s a Panic Attack? (And What Can Help)
subtitle: Psych Cat explains the scary feelings and how to ride them out
bodyHtml:
Sometimes your heart races, your chest tightens, your paws get clammy.
You feel like you might be dying.

Good news, human: you’re probably not.
Bad news: you’re having a panic attack. It’s scary, but it passes.

Here’s what Psych Cat wants you to know:

  • They peak fast.
    Most panic attacks last just a few minutes, even if it feels like forever.
  • Ground yourself.
    Look for 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste.
    This helps bring your brain back.
  • Breathe slow.
    In through your nose, out through your mouth. Big slow cat sighs.

If they keep happening, talk to a human doctor to figure out what’s under the fur.

Until then, breathe. Flick your tail. You’ve got this.
